soz: Fikrini çalarlar diye korkma. Asıl korkulacak şey, kimsenin umursaması.
sahne: A founder anxiously hugs a big locked safe with heavy chains and padlocks, looking around suspiciously. All around him, rows of empty chairs; nobody is there, nobody is looking. The mascot sits alone on one of the empty chairs, watching him.

soz: Müşteri ürün almaz. Sorununun bitmesini satın alır.
sahne: A person stands in heavy rain, soaking wet. Next to him a shelf full of fancy complicated gadgets that he ignores completely. He reaches with relief for one simple open umbrella standing next to the mascot. Rain drops drawn with pencil strokes.

soz: Nakit, girişimin oksijenidir. Hava bitince fikir kurtarmaz.
sahne: Underwater scene: a diver sits on the sea floor next to a beautiful glowing treasure chest, holding up the pressure gauge of his oxygen tank which points to almost empty. A few last bubbles rise. The mascot floats nearby, worried, with bubbles around it.

soz: Yatırımcı fikre değil, o fikri taşıyacak ekibe yatırım yapar.
sahne: A rowing race on a lake. Left: a very fancy shiny boat with only ONE person rowing alone, falling behind. Right: a simple wooden boat with four people rowing in perfect sync, moving fast; the mascot sits at the back of this boat like the coxswain. On the shore an investor figure points at the team boat.

soz: Mükemmeli bekleyen başlayamaz. Yamuk da olsa bitmiş ev kazanır.
sahne: Two building plots side by side. Left: a person still carefully polishing one single perfect brick with a cloth, surrounded by blueprints, nothing built. Right: a small slightly crooked but finished little house with smoke from the chimney, a happy person at the door, and the mascot standing proudly in front of it.

soz: Ürününü kopyalarlar. Ekibinin tutkusunu asla kopyalayamazlar.
sahne: Left: a big office photocopier spitting out many identical copies of the same product box, a competitor figure collecting them. Right: a team of four people sitting together around a warm campfire at night, working and laughing, the fire glowing; the mascot sits with them by the fire. The fire cannot be copied.

soz: Pazar büyük olabilir. Önemli olan senin dilimin.
sahne: A gigantic pizza covering a whole long table, with many people around it. A founder at the end of the table holds up proudly one tiny crumb-sized slice on a fork. The mascot stands next to him on the table, looking at the tiny slice.
